title: Invisible Lights
description: DataPack that adds an invisible light craft!
body:
![This is the crafting of invisible light](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9621986902d1a0c2cadf08d588eeee847d1c58cc.jpeg)DataPack that adds an invisible light craft!
With it, you can decorate your buildings without using ugly torches or lanterns.
Invisible light also has a simple craft that doesn't require much of your resources.
